title: QualityIssue
description: Standardized data quality and conformance issue finding produced by FHIRLint

id.description: Unique identifier for the issue finding

category.description: Classification category of the quality issue

ruleId.description: Identifier of the rule or conformance constraint that triggered the issue

resourceType.description: The FHIR resource type associated with the issue

resourceId.description: The logical ID of the resource associated with the issue

path.description: FHIRPath or JSONPath expression pinpointing the offending element

suggestion.description: Actionable guidance on how to remediate the defect
